key_impacts: Public and private buildings damaged and required structural assessment.
Large quantities of rubble and debris left by the earthquake.
evidence_snippets: Volunteer engagement in the 2015 Nepal earthquake.
A building remains standing after the earthquake but is rendered uninhabitable.
Demolition of structures terminally damaged by the earthquake and clearing the rubble.
7.8-magnitude earthquake that hit the Pacific Coast of Ecuador on 16 April 2016.
UNV established an Ecuador Earthquake Taskforce to coordinate recovery on the ground.
